# C3 DFlash nonfinite diagnosis — 2026-10-30

## Outcome

The exact original L request completes on the C3 `dcc853b55` ROCWMMA-OFF image, including its first 154-token prefill chunk, with the DFlash2 drafter active. The failed v10-based native-instrument build used ROCWMMA OFF and rejected 3,901,440 of 3,942,400 target feature floats after that same first chunk. ROCWMMA OFF by itself is therefore insufficient to cause the exact failure.

The failed trace launched `flash_attn_ext_f16<256,256,8,8>` 16 times. The successful C3-OFF warm trace launched the same specialization 32 times. C3 contains `f88127a86` (#27870), which repairs a divergent `__syncthreads()` in `flash_attn_ext_f16_process_tile`; v10 does not. Prior isolated OFF versus OFF plus #27870 testing on the 27B DFlash model passed only with the fix (`handoffs/active/kv-unified-stack-rollout.md`, V11-FA-2). These facts support the pre-#27870 numerical MMA defect as the cause. The exact L comparison also changes other v10-to-C3 source, so it is not by itself a single-change attribution to #27870.

No new kernel patch is needed in the C3 lane: `479ee3bbb` already contains #27870. The complete linked C3+native-instrument build and its own exact L control are still required to establish profiling compatibility. HTTP success on the uninstrumented C3 control proves the batch stayed below DFlash's rejection limit (16), not that every captured feature was finite.

## Controls and identity

| Arm | Image | ROCWMMA | Exact L result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Original C3, 2026-10-25 | `gpu-20261023-dcc853b55-c3` | ON | Warm/S/P completed; original `pass-L-original-run.json`. |
| Failed v10+instrument, 2026-10-30 | `/mnt/micron/refactor-nemo-native-build-20261030/hip-scheduled` | OFF | First 154-token chunk rejected 3,901,440/3,942,400 nonfinite target features; HTTP 500. |
| This control, 2026-10-30 | `gpu-20261023-dcc853b55-c3-rwoff` | OFF | Warm/S/P HTTP success, each 160 generated; warm/S 202 drafts and 130 accepted. |

The 45-element server argv for this control matches the failed arm after normalizing only the server binary and unique port. The original 200-token prefill breaks 154+42+4 on both successful C3 arms; v10 failed after 154. Original code prompt, Qwen3.8-27B-Q8_0 target, DFlash2-Q8_0 drafter, template, and request payload are unchanged. R7 requires CPU affinity 184-185 beside the correctness grant; this is the only other control change from the original launcher.

The C3-OFF build has `GGML_HIP_ROCWMMA_FATTN:BOOL=OFF`, pins `dcc853b55` in `PROVENANCE.md`, and its `libggml-hip.so.0.16.0` was built 2026-10-23 23:57:56Z, after #27870's 2026-10-20 commit. SHA-256 of that DSO: `64b569b4dc6fbdf28413763380425034805b56a10b2583e82614cf5f130e2b19`. Own ggml linkage verification passed. The failed binary's actual `CMakeCache.txt` also has ROCWMMA OFF, and its native trace records a 154-token target decode with rc 0 before the DFlash rejection.

This run held exclusive GPU quiet under the R7 smoke rule and was supervised for 285 seconds. The first lock attempt refused before inference because the earlier INF12 grant still covered the GPU; the accepted attempt started after that grant ended. Accepted run elapsed 58.32 seconds, peak owned VRAM 31.02 GiB sampled during inference, server PID 2272846 ended after SIGTERM with return code 0, and the supervisor drained its children.

## Evidence

- This control: `exact-L-C3-OFF/run.json` SHA-256 `74ff7b50652d9e86dbce863631ae962dcfa57d44765635ba64a657ab8e5aa66c`; `exact-L-C3-OFF/server.log` SHA-256 `5dba398fe2decf53e77467d8674bb216eaacd4eecdcd3421bfd9aab40a42dd21`; `runner-r3.log` SHA-256 `fa7c1bb99922414d0a6145abe0a9240c5b9c8c8397c97c29597dccf575ad254a`.

- Original C3 ON: `/mnt/raid0/llm/tmp/cal-1025/nemo-gpu-prof/out/pass-L/{run.json,server.log}` and `/mnt/raid0/llm/tmp/codex3-nemo-native-r1-20261030/pass-L-original-run.json`.
- Existing C3-OFF native feature checks: `/mnt/raid0/llm/tmp/c3-fold-prep/gate_g_runs/20261024T011501Z/probe/armgpu-20261023-dcc853b55-c3-rwoff.summary.txt` reports zero nonfinite features on 260- and 2,273-token probes; these are supplementary, not substitutes for the exact L request.

## Next controlled gate

Complete experimental C3+native source build `574d7a3b814f411564f54d568676e0f854063448` (479 plus checked Bolt INT32-array decoding), verify the executed DSO hashes, source commit, ROCWMMA cache, #27870 lineage, ggml generation/linkage, and actual GPU residency, then repeat original L under GPU quiet. Preserve the exact original payload/argv and report finite-feature counts if native instrumentation exposes them. If it fails, add per-layer/per-row feature counts and compare C3 with profiling enabled versus disabled on the *same* linked binary before changing the kernel.
